tools.description: Get account usage information including balance, quota, requests used, and billing details. Rate limited to 10 calls per minute.

tools.name: ujeebu_card
tools.description: Fast article preview extraction using meta tags. Returns title, summary, author, dates, image, and site info. Much faster than full extraction.

tools.name: ujeebu_chatgpt
tools.description: Fetch a URL and ask ChatGPT about it. Ujeebu loads the page, sends it to ChatGPT with your prompt, and returns the model's reply.

tools.name: ujeebu_checkout_link
tools.description: Create a Stripe checkout link for a credit top-up or a plan upgrade. Requires an API key. tools.name: ujeebu_extract
tools.description: Extract clean, structured data from news or blog articles. Returns main text/HTML, author, publish date, images, media, RSS feeds, and more.

tools.name: ujeebu_gemini
tools.description: Fetch a URL and ask Gemini about it. Ujeebu loads the page, sends it to Gemini with your prompt, and returns the model's reply.

tools.name: ujeebu_markdown
tools.description: Convert any web page into clean, LLM-optimized Markdown. Ideal for feeding page content to a model or RAG pipeline.

tools.name: ujeebu_plans
tools.description: Show the account's current plan, credits left, whether agent purchases are enabled (and the monthly cap and remaining amount), plus the available plans and credit top-ups with prices (in cents). Requires an API key. Use the plan/top-up ids from here as 'item' in ujeebu_checkout_link or ujeebu_buy.

tools.name: ujeebu_scrape_extract
tools.description: Extract structured data from web pages using custom rules. Define CSS selectors or XPath queries to extract specific data. Always returns JSON with extracted data.

tools.name: ujeebu_scrape_html
tools.description: Scrape and render web pages to get HTML content. Supports JavaScript execution, custom headers, scrolling, and content manipulation. Returns clean HTML or raw HTML.

tools.name: ujeebu_scrape_json
tools.description: General web scraping that always returns JSON response with metadata. Use this when you need structured response data including headers, status, timing info, and content. Can return HTML, screenshot, or PDF in JSON format.

tools.name: ujeebu_scrape_pdf
tools.description: Generate PDF from web pages. Supports custom page sizes, JavaScript execution, and rendering options. Returns base64-encoded PDF data.

tools.name: ujeebu_scrape_screenshot
tools.description: Take screenshots of web pages. Supports full page or partial screenshots, JavaScript execution, and custom viewport sizes. Returns base64-encoded image data.

tools.name: ujeebu_serp
tools.description: Retrieve Google search results programmatically. Supports web search, images, news, videos, and maps with customizable location, language, and device settings.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "ujeebu_signup_status" references sensitive artifacts (api_key, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Check a pending ujeebu_signup request. Works without a key. Poll about every 10 seconds (never faster than every 2 seconds). status values: pending_confirmation…

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "ujeebu_signup_status" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ujeebu_chatgpt, ujeebu_gemini, ujeebu_scrape_extract, ujeebu_scrape_html, ujeebu_scrape_json, ujeebu_scrape_pdf, ujeebu_scrape_screenshot, ujeebu_signup · Private data: ujeebu_buy, ujeebu_checkout_link, ujeebu_plans, ujeebu_signup · Public sink: ujeebu_extract, ujeebu_signup · Destructive: ujeebu_scrape_json.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ujeebu_chatgpt, ujeebu_gemini, ujeebu_scrape_extract, ujeebu_scrape_html, ujeebu_scrape_json, ujeebu_scrape_pdf, ujeebu_scrape_screenshot, ujeebu_signup · Private data: ujeebu_buy, ujeebu_checkout_link, ujeebu_plans, ujeebu_signup · Public sink: ujeebu_extract, ujeebu_signup · Destructive: ujeebu_scrape_json

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
